description: Investigate a commercial vehicle incident so the record is defensible and the cause is actually found — evidence secured in the first hours, the preventability decision made on stated criteria, and corrective action aimed at the system rather than the driver. Use when asked to investigate a vehicle accident, run a post-accident review, decide whether a collision was preventable, or write an incident report for a fleet. Not legal advice; involve your insurer and counsel early.
